The alarm rings a certain number of times each time it goes off, which corresponds to how long it rings. The first time it rang 4 times. The second time it rang three times as long, so it rang \(4 \times 3 = 12\) times. The third time it rang half as long as the second time, so it rang \(12 \div 2 = 6\) times. The total number of rings is \(4 + 12 + 6 = 22\).

Answer: 22
